name: cc-setup
description: Layer 3/5 of the cc-* harness — repo preparation. The skills that ground a repo before any build: feature-management (the declarative features and notes in docs/features/), architecture-management (the model.c4 tree in docs/architecture/), spec-management (detailed specs in docs/specs/ — placeholder). Plus one interview that fills them all: /setup draws everything out of the human and files each piece where it lives. Built on cc-tools; driven by cc-worker.
